recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source satisfies FHIR-14309; reverting to the literal historical low <= high expression would discard later boundary/comparability clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-14309 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes request from MnM to re-add the Range invariant once FHIRPath had Quantity comparison support: if low and high are present, low SHALL have a lower value than high.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied by git-svn commit 11f97b11d79b7132747af46442affd51e3ef35e5, whose message says GF#14309 and records svn revision 13459, matching the Jira comment. That commit re-enabled invariant id 2 in source/datatypes/range.xml after FHIR-14194 had disabled it as !2.
additional_context: FHIR-14194 explains that rng-2 was disabled because Quantity comparisons were not yet defined in FHIRPath, and FHIR-14308 supplied the needed Quantity comparison support. The linked Zulip topic confirms that dependency. Later commit 8a6a54029fdef0c2811fe4ea4e0286f84c1de7e3 refined the Range expression to use lowBoundary/highBoundary with a comparable guard, preserving the invariant under newer FHIRPath semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/fhir.ini actively lists Range under [types], and source/datatypes/range.xml already has invariant row 2 for context Range with the requested human text and a current Quantity-aware expression.
